relationships.subject: caspase-1
relationships.evidence_quote: GSDMD, a crucial mediator of pyroptosis downstream of canonical and non-canonical inflammasomes (39–41), is cleaved by caspase-1 at a specific site (GSDMD-NT)

key_findings: Mangiferin plus cinnamic acid, bioactive compounds of BHGZD, relieved pain and joint damage in adjuvant-induced arthritis rats.
The combination suppressed TLR4/PI3K/AKT/NF-kB signaling, NLRP3 inflammasome activation, caspase-1, IL-1beta and GSDMD-mediated pyroptosis in vivo and in RAW264.7 and MH7A cells.
